about: What install.sh installs, pinned. One flat object of strings, one per line, so the installer reads it before Node is on the machine. An empty value means not released yet: the installer refuses it rather than skip the check. The release runbook fills it in. go_image and go_image_digest name the official Go image the server compiles the shop programs in (bundle/lib/go-build.ts): the digest is the multi-arch index digest of go_image, looked up with `docker buildx imagetools inspect <go_image>`, and the tag is for people to read (what runs is golang@<digest>). Raise it only when the Go version in go/go.mod needs it.
